card.name: Linking words after a drug mention
card.fires_on: The small words "or" and "to" right after a drug or dose phrase, where the text is about to contrast the drug with placebo or with other causes. Seen in trial-arm lists and in "as opposed to".

modes.label: Drug or placebo
modes.description: The word "or" between a drug dose and placebo in a randomization sentence.
modes.example: force-titrated up to 45 mg daily<< or>> placebo (N=2633

modes.label: As opposed to
modes.description: The word "to" completing "as opposed to" after a drug is named as a possible cause.
modes.example: may be attributed to the antipsychotic drug as opposed<< to>> some characteristic(s) of the patients is

card.plain: It fires on the little word that sets a drug against an alternative, such as placebo or patient traits.
